title: Tool Manifest
description: Declares a host tool that can be auto-installed by the Vrooli runtime

name.description: Unique tool identifier matching the handler registry name

commands.description: Command names to check on PATH (first match wins)

versionArgs.description: Arguments passed to the resolved command to extract version output

defaultPackage.description: Fallback package name when the host package manager is not listed in packages

packages.description: Per-package-manager package name overrides (e.g. apt, brew, winget, dnf, pacman, apk)

installHint.description: Human-readable install guidance shown when the tool is missing

platforms.description: Platforms this tool applies to. Omit for all platforms.

handler.description: Name of a custom Go handler. When set, the generic package-install logic is bypassed.

notes.description: Freeform annotation for maintainers (not shown to users during install)

healthCheck.description: Optional post-install health check. If absent, command presence on PATH is sufficient.

command.description: Command to run for the health check

args.description: Arguments for the health check command

files.description: Files that must exist for the check to pass
